requests.reason: Embankment breach at Ward 2 primary school; 140 families stranded on rooftops.
Drinking water contamination and infant formula shortage reported by Camp Doctor.
Approved per DDMA flood severity matrix & routed to Godown Manager (ALC-503).

coordinations.callLog: Spoke with Insp. Vikram Rathore on VHF Ch-7. DEOC requested 2 immediate boat sorties behind primary school where 85 citizens are marooned. Team Alpha committed all 4 Zodiacs; 140 persons evacuated so far. Medical evacuation of 2 pregnant women prioritized to Mirza PHC.

coordinations.strength: 18 Divers & Rescuers • 2 Aluminium Boats • 1 Mobile Generator
coordinations.sector: Chaygaon Lowland Belt & Gumi Road Junction
coordinations.callLog: Direct telephone coordination with SI Manoj Baruah. SDRF unit arrived at Chaygaon ferry crossing. Clearing submerged approach road of driftwood to open access for food trucks. Assisting local administration in ferry shuttles for elderly citizens.

coordinations.strength: 1 Task Force Column (45 Jawans) • 6 BAUTs • 1 Mobile Field Hospital
coordinations.callLog: Conference call with Army Liaison Officer Maj. Swaminathan. Standby requisition acknowledged. Army column positioned at Mirza Stadium staging base. Requisition triggers if Brahmaputra crosses 18.50 m or if embankment breaches in West Kamrup.
